label: Autoscout24

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence medium). AutoScout24 Listing Creation API (public docs) for dealers/DMS partners; no public search API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://listing-creation.api.autoscout24.com/docs): AutoScout24 Listing Creation API (public docs) for dealers/DMS partners; no public search API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
